provenance.method: exact live /camera/color/camera_info from raw color mode; K and D stable across the session
provenance.vendor_undistortion_diagnostic: same-stamp raw and vendor image_undistorted were byte-identical despite non-zero D; adapter-owned OpenCV rectification is used

safety.reason: dataset requires hand-eye solve and full cross-split stability validation before any robot use

transform_convention.T_base_link7: maps a point expressed in link7 into base_link; p_base = T_base_link7 p_link7
transform_convention.T_camera_checkerboard: maps a checkerboard point into camera optical coordinates; p_camera = T_camera_checkerboard p_checkerboard
transform_convention.result_T_link7_camera_optical: maps a camera optical point into link7; p_link7 = T_link7_camera_optical p_camera
transform_convention.units: metres and radians unless a field name states otherwise
